equating.method: Every draw shares the same 300 public items (P, manifest 6b2321f8...). A fresh draw is equated to the reference draw with anchor systems measured on both draws (each draw lists its own anchor set): offset = median over anchors of (metric on the reference S u P) - (metric on the new draw S u P), for Intelligence and Calibration, with a bootstrap 95% interval over anchors and items. A row from that draw is shown as published plus the offset; Capability and Composite follow from the equated axes. Until the anchor runs of a draw are complete its offset is 0 and the draw is marked 'anchor runs pending'.
equating.offset_basis: median over anchors of (metric on v1.6.0 S u P) - (metric on d1027 S u P); applied by ADDING to a d1027 row (merged-board convention); I = post-penalty Intelligence at the reference G_med, C = Calibration
